text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 20, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "there were 20 helmets"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half as many robots as helmets"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half as many helmets as footballs"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "number of robots, half as many as the 20 helmets"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "number of footballs; helmets are half as many as footballs, so footballs = helmets / 0.5"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s3", "note": "helmets plus robots"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s3", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "add the footballs to get the total number of items Dominick saw"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the total number of items (robots, helmets, and footballs) Dominick saw"}, "dismissed": []}
